readiness.requestBody: Enable the request in the Electronic invoicing provider section. WARO will validate technical enablement with Matias before issuing.
readiness.pendingBody: The request may be active, but WARO must complete technical enablement with Matias before issuing.
readiness.missingFiscalBody: Complete NIT, legal name, phone and email in the Business fiscal data section.
readiness.noResolutionBody: Configure an active resolution with available numbering in the DIAN resolution section.
readiness.taxReviewBody: Enable INC or VAT only when it applies to your sales. If your business issues invoices without those taxes, confirm that fiscal data matches a non-VAT-liable natural person before saving.
readiness.matiasUuidBody: Configure the issuer client_uuid in the Electronic invoicing provider section before issuing with Matias.
readiness.ready: Your account is ready to issue electronic invoices.

resolutions.title: DIAN resolution
resolutions.emptySub: Configure the resolution you registered in the Matias portal (number, prefix, range)
resolutions.gapsTitle: Burned numbers detected in your numbering
resolutions.gapsHint: DIAN does not allow reusing them — check the log.
resolutions.currentNumberInvalid: Must be between {from} and {to}. DIAN does not allow reusing numbers; the counter only moves forward.

fiscal.body: Identifies the issuer before DIAN and Matias. These fields do not enable taxes by themselves or change VAT or INC calculations.
fiscal.orgHint: Defines whether the issuer invoices as a natural person or legal entity.
fiscal.taxRegimeHint: Describes the issuer’s fiscal responsibility; it does not replace sales tax toggles.
fiscal.taxLevelHint: Records additional issuer responsibilities such as large taxpayer or simple regime.

print.title: Customize POS tickets
print.bodyPrefix: Affects POS pre-invoices and printed receipts. The logo is configured in
print.docHint: Text at the top of the ticket (max. 40 characters). E.g. Pre-invoice, Order #.
print.tipHint: Tip line text on pre-invoice, printed receipt and email (max. 40 characters). E.g. Service.
print.showLogoHint: Use the My business logo on pre-invoice and printed invoice

tax.title: Taxes applied to sales
tax.body: These controls affect tax calculation and breakdowns in POS and invoices. They do not change your organization type or fiscal responsibility by themselves.
tax.incBody: Apply when sales must collect Impoconsumo. Affects the total and invoice breakdown.
tax.ivaBody: Enable only if sales must include 19% VAT. Affects the total and invoice breakdown.
tax.liquorBody: For bottles or takeaway spirits when applicable; always added to the base price.
tax.incIncludedHint: The 8% is already included in the price. Example: $10,800 → $10,000 base + $800 INC
tax.incAddedHint: The 8% is added on top. Example: $10,000 base → $10,800 charged
tax.ivaIncludedHint: The 19% is already included in the price. Example: $11,900 → $10,000 base + $1,900 VAT
tax.ivaAddedHint: The 19% is added on top. Example: $10,000 base → $11,900 charged

provider.title: Electronic invoicing provider
provider.requestBody: Indicates that you want to issue electronic invoices from WARO. This request does not replace internal enablement with Matias or change VAT or INC.
provider.matiasUuidHint: Issuer client_uuid identifier in Matias for Casa de Software. It is a technical provider requirement; it does not define your fiscal regime or sales taxes.
